descriptor: GHOSTRACE — local macOS causal event journal

decision.public_descriptor: GHOSTRACE — local macOS causal event journal
rationale: The bare GhostRace name has an established VUSec security-research collision.
The qualified descriptor distinguishes this local macOS journal without implying affiliation.
Distribution identifiers add the journal qualifier before any broadly distributed release.

identifiers.migration_boundary: Rename package, binary, formula, and bundle identifiers before first broadly distributed release; keep the repository name only if counsel accepts the qualified descriptor.

collision_review.observed: VUSec and collaborators use GhostRace for speculative race-condition research and publish a public implementation.
collision_review.action: Do not imply affiliation, reuse VUSec branding, or describe this project as the VUSec work.

collision_review.observed: The GitHub repository search returned 73 repositories, including multiple unrelated GhostRace/Ghostrace projects and this repository.
collision_review.action: Treat the repository namespace as non-unique and retain the qualified descriptor.

collision_review.observed: The exact search and API requests were rejected by the provider policy; no absence claim is made.
collision_review.action: Keep publication disabled and repeat the exact registry check manually before release.

collision_review.observed: The exact formula URL returned HTTP 404 at audit time; this is not a reservation or legal clearance.
collision_review.action: Use ghostrace-journal as the proposed formula name and recheck Homebrew before submission.

collision_review.observed: The exact npm registry search returned zero objects.
collision_review.action: No npm package is planned; repeat the check if a JavaScript adapter is ever published.

collision_review.observed: The exact PyPI project endpoint returned HTTP 404; this is not a reservation or legal clearance.
collision_review.action: No Python package is planned; repeat the check if a Python adapter is ever published.

collision_review.observed: RDAP responses are recorded without retaining registrant identity. Registered domains are not available namespace signals.
collision_review.action: Do not infer domain availability; a domain purchase, if needed, requires a separate legal and registrar review.

collision_review.observed: Search results include forensic scanners, an AI pentesting service, a reverse-engineering workbench, an LLC, and games using GhostTrace or GhostRacer.
collision_review.action: Use the journal descriptor in search-facing copy and avoid unqualified adjacent names.

uspto.observed: The official TMSearch service returned zero exact wordmark records for the audit request. This is an observation, not a clearance opinion; related marks, goods/services, common-law use, and later filings require counsel review.

euipo.observed: The official eSearch plus endpoint returned zero exact mark records for the audit request. This is an observation, not a clearance opinion; similar marks, classifications, national records, and later filings require counsel review.

legal_review.limitation: No trademark, corporate, domain, or legal clearance is asserted. A qualified trademark counsel must review the proposed descriptor and release identifiers before broad distribution.

required_before: crates.io, Homebrew, npm, or PyPI publication
domain registration or paid naming commitment
rerun_policy.retained_data: Public URLs, query terms, result states, and counts only; no registrant identity, account data, or private correspondence.
